description: Suijin OS v5.4.0 — the capability ecosystem. Person-to-person package distribution: .sjm module packs, .sja addons and .sjp kernel plugins as single sealed files (SHA-256 sums, path-traversal and zip-bomb guards, tool-shadowing refusal). A built-in AST-only safety scanner refuses hidden eval/exec, hardcoded secrets, obfuscated blobs and built-in tool shadowing — it never executes payload code, and install always re-scans source. The suijin install wizard shows attribution, dev note, scan verdict and the full tool table; Enter installs. Ships three sealed example packages plus five malicious scanner fixtures proving the guards end-to-end. Field fixes: spinner 3x faster, RunBox shares the engagement console, search_kb accepts its documented args. 1,597 tests green.
